what: Finding 1: 0-finding rounds are only handled inside tally-plan-review.sh, but the real plan-review loop exits before invoking tally
scenario_or_breakage: /design runs with no collected FINDING/OOS blocks will still emit skipped-empty-findings and never create plan-review/round-N/findings-classification.tsv, missing the acceptance criterion that every 0-findings round writes a header-only TSV
suggested_fix: Update the zero-finding branch to create DESIGN_TMPDIR/plan-review/round-$ROUND_NUM and write the header-only TSV or invoke tally-plan-review.sh on the empty ballot with --findings-classification-out; add a plan-review-loop harness assertion for that artifact

what: Finding 2: Sorting only available voter files and assigning v1/v2/v3 shifts later tools left when a middle voter is absent
scenario_or_breakage: If Codex is missing but Claude and Cursor files exist, Cursor is written into v2 instead of v3, violating the fixed v1=Claude v2=Codex v3=Cursor convention and corrupting degraded-panel analytics
suggested_fix: Map each parsed voter file to a fixed canonical slot by tool name or nominal filename, leave absent slots empty, and add a Codex-missing test case in addition to the Cursor-missing case

what: Finding 3: Parser contract says axis values are matched case-insensitively but also emitted case-preserved, conflicting with the lowercase stdout schema
scenario_or_breakage: A voter line like SEVERITY=MAJOR would be accepted but could emit PARSED_SEVERITY=MAJOR, which is outside the documented enum and can break downstream TSV consumers
suggested_fix: Normalize recognized axis values to the documented lowercase enum before emit_kv; add parser fixtures for uppercase and mixed-case axis tokens

what: Finding 4: The plan changes several existing scripts but omits their sibling contract updates
scenario_or_breakage: The repo rule requires updating sibling .md files with behavior changes; tally-plan-review.sh, plan-review-loop.sh, design-log-publish.sh, render-voter-prompt.sh, lib-voter-parse-rate.sh, test-render-voter-prompt.sh, test-tally-plan-review.sh, and test-design-log-publish.sh would ship stale contracts
suggested_fix: Update each affected sibling .md to document the new CLI flag, TSV artifact, prompt format, retry format, publisher allowlist, and harness coverage

what: Finding 5: The new Makefile target is registered but not added to the canonical Makefile-target documentation
scenario_or_breakage: Users and maintainers consulting docs/linting.md will not find make test-findings-classification even though the plan adds it to make lint through a shard
suggested_fix: Add a docs/linting.md row for make test-findings-classification near the existing plan-review tally and voter prompt harness entries
